item.title: Again Defying Trump, Congress Proposes Increasing NIH Budget, Maintaining ED
item.description: Again Defying Trump, Congress Proposes Increasing NIH Budget, Maintaining ED Ryan Quinn Tue, 01/20/2026 - 04:45 PM Appropriators have released legislation that wouldn’t defund Education Department programs or slash the National Institutes of Health budget.
